dimensions.name: PREMISE_MATURITY
dimensions.description: Core conflict should match the target reader's autonomy and conceptual range rather than relying on vocabulary to imply maturity.

dimensions.name: NARRATIVE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support layered goals, changing information, reversals, parallel pressures, and earned resolution.

dimensions.name: CONCEPTUAL_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Allow systems, institutions, evidence, ethics, ambiguity, identity, responsibility, and competing explanations at the target level.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_DEPTH
dimensions.description: Important outcomes should arise from several linked causes, decisions, constraints, and consequences.

dimensions.name: INFERENCE_DEMAND
dimensions.description: Allow meaningful unstated connections and interpretation without making essential causality opaque.

dimensions.name: AGENCY_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: The protagonist should make consequential strategic choices among credible alternatives.

dimensions.name: STAKES_CONSEQUENCE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Stakes may affect reputation, relationships, livelihood, access, identity, institutions, safety, or world state without becoming melodramatic by default.

dimensions.name: SOCIAL_RELATIONSHIP_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support mixed motives, power differences, trust, conflict, loyalty, negotiation, and changing relationships without flattening people into roles.

dimensions.name: PREDICTABILITY_CHALLENGE
dimensions.description: Avoid obvious one-beat solutions; permit wrong models, reversals, incomplete information, and trade-offs.

dimensions.name: WONDER_DISCOVERY
dimensions.description: Adventure-oriented stories should still offer discovery, exploration, systems, mystery, or experiences larger than routine simulation.

dimensions.name: LANGUAGE_READABILITY
dimensions.description: Use clear, natural language appropriate to an independent adult reader; complexity should come from thought and structure, not unnecessary opacity.

required_story_capabilities: A protagonist with a credible age-appropriate role and independent agency
At least one layered objective, unresolved question, or competing priority
Multi-step causality with consequences that accumulate across the episode
A meaningful change in understanding rather than simple clue collection
A consequential choice, strategic trade-off, or irreversible local action
A local episode payoff that does not prematurely close long-horizon questions
Persistent consequence or reusable world-state value when earned
Adventure-oriented modes should include genuine discovery, exploration, mystery, or systems engagement
reject_signals: A premise made to feel older mainly through harder vocabulary
One obvious attempt solves the central problem without meaningful complication
The protagonist mostly observes while another character resolves the core problem
Exposition or lore substitutes for scene-level causality and choice
Mystery or conflict resolves by coincidence, withheld information, or unearned revelation
Violence, trauma, romance, cynicism, or darkness is added merely to signal maturity
The world could be replaced by a generic setting without materially changing the problem
language_rules: Prefer precise natural language over ornamental density
Domain-specific terminology is allowed when it serves action, reasoning, profession, or world logic and remains understandable in context
Do not use vocabulary difficulty as a substitute for premise or conceptual maturity
Let dialogue, action, evidence, and consequence carry interpretation where practical
Avoid juvenile narration unless the exact character voice or scene intentionally calls for it
safety_rules: Maturity does not require graphic violence, sexual content, trauma, or despair
Tension, danger, loss, rivalry, moral uncertainty, and difficult relationships may appear when relevant and proportionate
Do not force age stereotypes, illness, frailty, parenthood, nostalgia, or romance merely because the reader is older
calibration_notes: Age-40 qualification should support complex responsibility, institutional memory, long consequences, expertise, and relationship nuance without stereotyping life stage.
Do not assume parenthood, management status, nostalgia, cynicism, illness, or reduced appetite for adventure.
Product session length remains separately governed by the cross-age qualification matrix.
Cross-age qualification authority: STANDARD product session is fixed at 1,600–2,500 words for the first controlled 12/18/25/40/60 proof so maturity is isolated from length.

character.name: Mira
character.origin_summary: Mira has spent fifteen years surveying coastal infrastructure where old engineering and new development overlap.
character.current_role: survey lead authorized to recommend temporary access restrictions

identity_anchors.statement: Mira treats public safety claims as obligations, not rhetorical leverage.

core_drives.drive: Keep the causeway usable without hiding evidence that the system is changing.

internal_tensions.side_a: Closing access harms the island community.
internal_tensions.side_b: Leaving access open without evidence can be irresponsible.
internal_tensions.description: Either decision imposes real costs on people she knows.

immediate_avoidances: making a political convenience look like technical certainty

origin.summary: Mira has spent fifteen years surveying coastal infrastructure where old engineering and new development overlap.

facts.fact: Mira can recommend temporary causeway restrictions but cannot order permanent reconstruction alone.

formative_events.summary: Mira led a post-storm inspection that preserved access by finding a repairable fault.
formative_events.impact: She learned that closure and openness can both be lazy answers without diagnosis.

unresolved_questions.question: How much of the original foundation still carries load at spring tide?

current_situation.summary: Sensors show a new resonance during spring tide just as the island council presses to keep the causeway open for a major supply convoy.
current_situation.current_role: survey lead authorized to recommend temporary access restrictions
current_situation.current_location_context: Main Causeway, Tide Vault inspection chamber, and East Pier monitoring station
current_open_questions: Is the resonance a harmless sensor interaction, a local joint fault, or a deeper foundation change?
immediate_avoidances: making a political convenience look like technical certainty
notes: Mira has no authority to fabricate safety certification.

relationships.subject: Kaan
relationships.trust_or_tension: Kaan favors conservative closure; Mira wants one more discriminating test.
known_facts: Both share the same sensor logs.

relationships.subject: Leyla
relationships.trust_or_tension: Leyla needs access but cannot dictate technical findings.

memories.summary: Mira remembers a prior case where one targeted test prevented an unnecessary closure.

world.habitat: tidal archipelago linked by aging modular causeways
world.technology_level: modern structural sensors, drones, portable diagnostics
world.summary: The coast depends on infrastructure layered over older foundations that respond unpredictably to stronger tides.
social_context: technical recommendations have public and political consequences
island supply chains depend on narrow access windows
known_pressures: rising tide variability strains old structures

known_world_facts: The resonance is new but not yet diagnosed.
The convoy matters to island supplies.
Mira can recommend temporary restrictions but not declare permanent structural failure.

main.title: Shifting Foundations
main.goal: Understand how old coastal foundations are adapting to new tidal loads before policy outruns evidence.
main.stakes: Bad technical certainty can either endanger people or isolate communities unnecessarily.
main.central_mystery: Several old structures show correlated changes without one established cause.

eligible_milestones.summary: Mira isolates at least one condition that produces or suppresses the new resonance.
eligible_milestones.state_condition: A controlled field comparison narrows the plausible causes.
consequence_options: A bounded follow-up opportunity may become available.

public_long_term_questions.question: Why are several older coastal structures changing response together?

opportunities.title: Spring-tide diagnostic window
opportunities.summary: Mira can collect one high-load comparison before the convoy decision.

approved_premise.title: The Causeway at Spring Tide
approved_premise.logline: With a supply convoy approaching, Mira has one spring-tide window to distinguish between a local repairable fault and a deeper causeway problem before issuing a recommendation that carries real community costs.
approved_premise.protagonist_role: Mira is the technical decision owner who must interpret evidence, negotiate pressure, and choose a proportionate recommendation.
approved_premise.immediate_objective: Narrow the cause of the resonance enough to justify a defensible temporary access decision.
approved_premise.inciting_event: A resonance spike appears only when two support zones carry load together, contradicting the simple bad-sensor explanation.
approved_premise.central_problem: Each additional test improves diagnosis but consumes the same time needed to prepare safe convoy controls.
approved_premise.wonder_or_discovery: Old foundation geometry visible in the Tide Vault suggests the modern load model may be missing a structural interaction.
approved_premise.stakes: Closing the causeway disrupts supplies and credibility; leaving it open without adequate evidence risks safety and professional trust.
constraints: Mira cannot certify what has not been tested.
Political pressure cannot count as technical evidence.
One episode cannot establish the region-wide cause.
approved_premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: Mira must choose between one deeper diagnostic test with less preparation time or a conservative restricted-access recommendation based on current evidence.
approved_premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Are similar resonances at other structures caused by the same buried foundation pattern?
approved_premise.local_payoff: End with a defensible bounded recommendation and a clearer causal model, not total certainty.
persistent_outcomes_possible: Professional trust with Kaan or Leyla may shift.
A follow-up regional survey may become justified.

creation_constraints: Engineering claims must follow observed data and authority limits.
forbidden_creations: Political character secretly causing the structural issue

authority_rules: Spine may use only facts, states, permissions and questions present in this pack.
A model may invent transient scene texture but not durable canon unless creative_permission_envelope permits it.
Hidden truth answers are absent from this pack and must not be inferred as fact.
RUMORED locations are foreshadow-only; locked/limited locations obey their premise_usage.
Only eligible milestones may be targeted, and a spine cannot itself commit completion.
Inventory capability must come from inventory entries or explicit world/character authority.
Relationships may evolve only through earned episode actions; starting state remains authoritative.
Persistent outcomes remain candidates until delivered prose and post-story commit earn them.
hard_freezes: Mira cannot certify what has not been tested.
Political pressure cannot count as technical evidence.
One episode cannot establish the region-wide cause.
End with a defensible bounded recommendation and a clearer causal model, not total certainty.
Do not reveal or assert hidden Saga answers absent from this pack.
Do not silently change the supplied authority revisions/fingerprint.

anti_repetition.rule: New spine should be materially distinct from recent story shapes unless the approved premise requires reuse.
